title: The Agent creates a message, issue, or comment that explicitly flags the person(s) who shipped parameter changes across the features without design sign-off.
justification: The prompt explicitly says 'flag whoever shipped changes without design sign-off.' This is a goal-level ask - the agent may flag via Slack message, a new Linear issue, a dedicated comment, or similar. Method-agnostic language is used because the prompt says 'flag' without specifying the medium.
evidence: Look for any communication action (Slack message, Linear issue creation, or dedicated comment) that explicitly identifies and calls out the person responsible for merging parameter-changing PRs without design review. This may be a standalone message, a new tracking issue, or a clearly labeled flag section within a ticket comment.

evidence: Check the content of the ENG-2424 update or comment for a mention of the Figma reference belonging to someone other than the original designer, or a note that the referenced Figma is external to the design team's work.

evidence: Check the content of the ENG-2428 update or comment for references to specific reward changes (e.g., 'Bones' reward type, token doubling, alternative spreadsheet, IAP entries) that differ from the original 'ZM3D Season Pass - Spec' design.

evidence: Check the agent's final response or trajectory for reference to the Combo Fighter GDD's gold-only economy rule, the 'no second currency' statement, or equivalent language establishing that the GDD did not include gems, tickets, or rarity tiers.

evidence: Check the agent's final response or trajectory for identification of PR #34 (title 'IAP', branch 'Blake/IAP') in the Combo-Fighters repo, noting it introduced Gems and/or Tickets as new currencies not in the GDD.
